warnings: One record per observation. API and consumer-surface observations must never share a silent rollup: any aggregate must state its lane and surface.
If retrieval_ran is false in the retrieval lane, the observation is still valid but must be reported in its own subgroup, not merged with retrieval-grounded answers.
validity_status must be set before analysis. Invalid runs are counted and reported, never silently dropped.

observation_record_template.proximity_band: B0_direct_brand_product | B1_comparison_purchase | B2_category | B3_problem_need | B4_job_goal | B5_broad_discovery_story
observation_record_template.exact_prompt_text: <verbatim string issued, including TURN markers for scripted multi-turn>
observation_record_template.raw_payload_ref: <path or object key; raw payloads retained separately, not inlined here>

aggregation_rules: Group by (panel_version, wave_id, lane, surface_id, locale, aided_status, partition) before computing any rate.
Never pool aided statuses. Never pool lanes. Never pool API and consumer-surface observations.
Cluster by canonical_cell_id for interval estimation; variants and repeats are nested observations, not independent buyers.
Report eligible runs, invalid runs and invalid reasons alongside every rate.
Report a subgroup as counts plus example responses, not a percentage leaderboard, whenever it contains fewer than 20-30 distinct canonical cells.
